title: Compress PDF for Email Attachments (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo) — Under 10MB/25MB
metaDescription: Compress PDF file size for email attachments. Reduce large PDFs to send via Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and Yahoo without bounce-back errors. Free & private in-browser tool.
docType: Presentation, Contract, Multi-page Report, Scan Portfolio
heroDescription: Reduce oversized PDF documents so they bypass Gmail (25MB), Outlook (20MB), and Yahoo Mail attachment limits instantly without cloud uploads.
privacyNote: Your sensitive email attachments and corporate files are processed locally inside your browser.

sections.heading: Bypass email bounce-backs and recipient mailbox limits.
body: Sending PDFs larger than 10–20 MB over email often results in annoying bounce notifications like 'Message size exceeds recipient gateway limit' or forces attachments into external cloud drive links.
Zcompressor optimizes your PDF document streams locally, shrinking file size by up to 80% so your attachments send instantly directly inside standard email messages.

faq.q: What is the best PDF size for email attachments?
faq.a: Keeping your PDF under 5 MB to 10 MB ensures it delivers quickly and reliably across all corporate and webmail providers without triggering recipient spam filters or attachment caps.
